subject.title: feat(browser): expand Chrome MCP web capabilities

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's expanded Browser Chrome MCP authority and capability policy as the permanent boundary, or should it be narrowed or split before merge?
rationale: The diff adds model-reachable browser diagnostics, extension mutation, page-provided tool execution, WebMCP execution, new config policy, and CI import-cycle semantics that require maintainer intent beyond code correctness.

options.title: Accept With Owner Gate And Refresh
options.body: Require Browser/security owner acceptance, resolve the current conflicts, and rerun Browser/config/scripts validation on the refreshed head before merge.

options.title: Split Automation Policy
options.body: Move the type-only import-cycle checker change into a separate PR so CI architecture policy is reviewed independently of Browser capability expansion.

options.title: Narrow Capability Scope
options.body: Limit this branch to diagnostics and artifact readback first if maintainers are not ready to accept extension mutation or page-provided tool execution.

recommendation.title: Accept With Owner Gate And Refresh
recommendation.body: Require Browser/security owner acceptance, resolve the current conflicts, and rerun Browser/config/scripts validation on the refreshed head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Browser plugin history points to steipete as the strongest current routing candidate for the Browser capability and owner-boundary decision.
